 Shop Manager at OSKA Maastricht 
 Open position Shop Manager at OSKA Maastricht 
OSKA is located on Maastricht's most charming shopping street, Maastrichter Smedenstraat. 
OSKA is a unique, internationally operating clothing company that stands for quality, style and sustainability. OSKA has seven brand stores in the Netherlands and a successful online shop. 
We are looking for a driven shop manager with Maastricht flair who understands the importance of atmosphere, service and customer focus. As shop manager, you will run the entire organisation of this beautiful shop, from stock management, CRM activities and visual merchandising to managing your team, ensuring that they are satisfied and can function effectively. You will be able to handle this multifaceted job with ease. 
Do you see this job as a challenge, do you have experience in the fashion industry, are you spontaneous and do you have a good sense of fashion and people? Are you available 4 to 5 days a week? Then we would very much like to meet you. 
What do we offer? 
A dream job in Maastricht at a sustainable company! 
You will be working in a friendly, collegial and professional team. You will receive a competitive salary and excellent fringe benefits.. 
What will you be doing? 
In addition to stock management, visual merchandising and keeping track of sales figures, you will of course be involved in customer loyalty, personnel management and CRM. 
What do we require from you? 
● MBO/HBO working and thinking level 
● Independence and creativity in thinking and functioning 
● Good computer skills 
● You have experience in the fashion industry 
● You have knowledge of the Dutch and English languages 
● You dare to make choices 
● You are commercially and customer-oriented. 
● You function well in a team but also independently 
Are you interested? 
Come visit us in the shop, and we will show you your new workplace. If you are enthusiastic, send a cover letter with your CV...
